title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
title_zh: 4DMemory：用框架增强智能体对长时程时空记忆进行基准测试

paragraphs.en: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench . LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness , which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

paragraphs.en: Humans do not always know in advance which aspects of an unfolding experience will matter to a future goal. They form long-term memories as the world evolves and, once a concrete goal arises, selectively retrieve relevant experiences, integrate them with new observations, and update their current understanding ( Tulving and Thomson, 1973 ; Hupbach et al., 2007 ) . This interaction between persistent memory and goal-directed recall enables reasoning across long temporal horizons. As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance from static-image perception toward video understanding and multimodal reasoning ( Maaz et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Gemini Team, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) , developing an analogous capability becomes increasingly important for artificial systems. Long-horizon 4D tasks require models to preserve how entities, spatial relations, states, and events evolve over time, so that observations made hours earlier can inform later reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 人类并不总是能提前知道一段正在展开的经历中哪些方面会对未来的目标至关重要。 他们随着世界的演进而形成长期记忆，一旦出现具体目标，便选择性地检索相关经历，将其与新观察整合，并更新当前的理解（Tulving and Thomson, 1973；Hupbach et al., 2007）。 这种持久记忆与目标导向回忆之间的交互，使得跨越长时间跨度的推理成为可能。 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）从静态图像感知迈向视频理解与多模态推理（Maaz et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024a；Gemini Team, 2024；Wang et al., 2024a），为人工系统开发类似的能力变得越来越重要。 长时程 4D 任务要求模型保留实体、空间关系、状态和事件随时间演变的方式，从而让数小时前的观察结果能够为后续推理提供依据。

paragraphs.en: Although modern MLLMs perform strongly on many vision-language tasks, they remain poorly matched to long-horizon 4D reasoning. First, a nominally long context window does not imply an equally long effective video context, as dense video generates long sequences of visual tokens that impose substantial computational and memory costs during visual encoding and attention. Practical systems therefore depend on sparse frame sampling or token compression, which may discard fine-grained evidence before the eventual task is known ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) . Second, strong long-text reasoning does not by itself provide the multimodal alignment, temporal reasoning, and spatial understanding needed to connect events across changing scenes ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . As a result, directly processing hours of video with an MLLM remains unreliable for complex 4D tasks whose evidence is distributed across distant moments, scenes, and temporal scales.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管现代多模态大语言模型在许多视觉-语言任务上表现出色，但它们与长时程 4D 推理仍然很不匹配。 首先，名义上的长上下文窗口并不意味着同样长的有效视频上下文，因为密集的视频会生成很长的视觉 token 序列，在视觉编码和注意力计算过程中带来巨大的计算与内存开销。 因此，实际系统依赖于稀疏帧采样或 token 压缩，而这可能在最终任务尚不明确时就丢弃细粒度的证据 ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) 。 其次，强大的长文本推理本身并不能提供连接跨变化场景事件所需的多模态对齐、时序推理和空间理解能力 ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) 。 结果，对于证据分布在遥远时刻、不同场景和多种时间尺度上的复杂 4D 任务而言，直接用多模态大语言模型处理数小时的视频仍然不可靠。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has addressed these limitations through complementary interventions at the system, model, and method levels. At the system level, agentic harnesses iteratively retrieve query-relevant frames, maintain structured temporal and object memories, and orchestrate multi-granular search or specialist tools ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . At the model level, long-video MLLMs extend their effective visual horizon through long-context training, compact per-frame tokenization, and explicit temporal encoding ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . At the method level, adaptive spatiotemporal compression removes redundant frames and visual tokens, sparse memory consolidates dense observations into long-term representations, and query-adaptive hierarchical selection allocates computation across temporal granularities ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Together, these advances improve access to long-range evidence, but their gains are typically evaluated under different datasets, interfaces, and access conditions, making it difficult to isolate improvements in the base model, evidence acquisition, memory, and final reasoning. Moreover, these components are not readily composable across systems, since methods such as LongVU require access to the internal vision-token pipeline, whereas LongVT learns its tool-use protocol through model-specific post-training of Qwen2.5-VL-7B rather than through a model-agnostic plug-in interface ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作通过在系统、模型和方法层面的互补干预来解决这些局限。 在系统层面，智能体框架迭代式地检索与查询相关的帧，维护结构化的时间与对象记忆，并编排多粒度搜索或专用工具（ Wang et al., 2024b ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ）。 在模型层面，长视频多模态大语言模型通过长上下文训练、紧凑的逐帧分词以及显式的时间编码来扩展其有效视觉范围（ Chen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Bai et al., 2025 ）。 在方法层面，自适应时空压缩去除冗余帧和视觉标记，稀疏记忆将密集观察整合为长期表示，而查询自适应的分层选择则在不同时间粒度之间分配计算（ Shen et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ）。 总体而言，这些进展改善了长程证据的获取，但它们的增益通常是在不同的数据集、接口和访问条件下评估的，因此难以将基础模型、证据获取、记忆和最终推理方面的改进区分开来。 此外，这些组件无法方便地在不同系统之间组合，因为诸如 LongVU 之类的方法需要访问内部视觉标记流水线，而 LongVT 则是通过对 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 进行模型特定的后训练来学习其工具使用协议，而非通过模型无关的插件接口（ Shen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ）。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, expanding a model’s nominal context window determines how much input it can accept, but not how much distributed evidence it can use effectively, as performance degrades with increasing context length and task complexity even when all relevant evidence is perfectly retrieved ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2025 ) . External memory and RAG reduce the raw context presented at once, but shift the bottleneck to deciding what to store, compress, update, retrieve, and ultimately use; current systems can lose visual fidelity during memory construction and remain far below human performance on long-term temporal and causal reasoning ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2026 ) . Reusable skills and tools provide procedural guidance and specialist capabilities, but their gains depend strongly on the task and harness, while reliable execution requires correct routing and parameter grounding and deteriorates as tool catalogs, tool outputs, and interaction histories grow ( Li et al., 2026c ; Kate et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . Consequently, as task horizons and dependency depth grow by orders of magnitude, errors accumulate across memory construction, retrieval, skill selection, and reasoning, and current systems have yet to demonstrate stable and reliable performance on complex multimodal tasks that demand human-like episodic recall, temporal integration, memory updating, and coordinated action.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，扩大模型的标称上下文窗口决定了它能接受多少输入，但不能决定它能有效利用多少分布式证据，因为即使所有相关证据都被完美检索到，随着上下文长度和任务复杂度的增加，性能仍会下降（Hsieh et al., 2024；Du et al., 2025）。 外部记忆和 RAG 减少了一次性呈现的原始上下文，但将瓶颈转移到了决定存储、压缩、更新、检索并最终使用什么内容上；当前系统在记忆构建过程中可能丢失视觉保真度，并且在长期时序和因果推理上仍远低于人类水平（Maharana et al., 2024；Ren et al., 2026）。 可复用的技能和工具提供了程序性指导和专业能力，但其收益在很大程度上取决于任务和运行框架，而可靠的执行需要正确的路由和参数落地，并且随着工具目录、工具输出和交互历史的增长而变差（Li et al., 2026c；Kate et al., 2025；Shen et al., 2026）。 因此，随着任务时间跨度和依赖深度按数量级增长，误差会在记忆构建、检索、技能选择和推理过程中不断累积，而当前系统尚未在需要类人情节回忆、时序整合、记忆更新和协调行动的复杂多模态任务上展现出稳定可靠的性能。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, we introduce LongVideo, a dataset comprising over 1,000 standalone long videos and two multi-season television series, with approximately 900 hours of video in total. Based on LongVideo, we build LongVideo , which contains more than 5,000 question-answer pairs and combines multi-evidence questions on individual videos with episode-, season-, and complete-series queries across visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning. To support a broad range of LLMs and MLLMs, we further develop the 4DMemory Harness . Following the principle of task-independent storage and goal-directed recall, the harness first constructs reusable, question-independent memories of long video streams and then performs question-conditioned retrieval and specialized evidence acquisition when a concrete task arrives. This design decouples the temporal scope of a task from the model’s native context window, allowing the foundation model and the harness to operate together as the 4DMemory Agent .

paragraphs.en: Existing long-video benchmarks primarily evaluate reasoning over individual videos lasting one to two hours. Even for LLMs and MLLMs with context windows exceeding 1M tokens, these settings alone do not establish whether models can match human abilities to extract and retain fine-grained evidence, or preserve, integrate, and use key information after receiving tens of hours of additional video. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 4 , we organize video, audio, and textual annotations into chronological records linked by source identifiers and timestamps. For standalone videos, each record associates sampled frames and visual captions with the corresponding audio segments and available ASR transcripts. For television sources, multimodal annotation additionally provides scene summaries, speaker-labelled dialogue, and utterance-level temporal boundaries. Segment-local timestamps are mapped back to the original source timeline to preserve temporal correspondence across modalities. This representation supports both continuous video timelines and episode–season–series hierarchies. Records passing a unified quality threshold are retained for compositional QA construction and verification, while reference answers, annotated evidence locations, and reasoning programs remain private during evaluation. Preprocessing and alignment details can be referred in the Section S2.2 .

paragraphs.en: We turn the aligned records into questions that require combining evidence, rather than recalling an isolated fact. For standalone videos, the generator receives time-ordered evidence cards containing clip summaries, available ASR, and temporal bounds. Each candidate connects 2 to 4 clips through an explicit operation such as comparison, temporal ordering, state change, cross-modal binding, or distributed counting. A separate verifier checks the answer and the joint necessity of the evidence by removing each supporting clip in turn. Only 3 to 5 accepted questions are retained per video, yielding 4,388 QA pairs.

paragraphs.en: Complex tasks over long multimodal histories require both access to diverse evidence and selective recall of earlier observations. Although modern LLMs can compress context and invoke skills, these capabilities do not remove the constraints imposed by native input support and finite context windows. Repeated compression may also omit details that become relevant to subsequent questions. We therefore introduce 4DMemory Harness , which separates media processing, persistent memory, and question-conditioned reasoning. The harness exposes three processing skills—video processing, visual grounding, and text statistics—and stores question-independent, timestamped observations in persistent structured memory. A lightweight retrieval layer selects relevant records and their temporal neighbors to provide bounded evidence for reasoning. When the visual input pathway does not carry audio, an internal transcription module processes the available source audio and incorporates timestamped speech evidence into the corresponding memory records.
paragraphs.zh: 处理长多模态历史中的复杂任务，既需要访问多样化的证据，也需要对早期观察进行选择性回忆。 尽管现代大语言模型能够压缩上下文并调用技能，但这些能力并不能消除原生输入支持和有限上下文窗口所带来的约束。 反复压缩还可能遗漏与后续问题相关的细节。 因此，我们提出 4DMemory Harness，它将媒体处理、持久记忆和基于问题的推理相互分离。 该 Harness 提供三种处理技能——视频处理、视觉定位和文本统计——并将与问题无关的、带时间戳的观察存储到持久结构化记忆中。 一个轻量级检索层会选取相关记录及其时间上的邻近记录，为推理提供有界的证据。 当视觉输入通路不携带音频时，内部转录模块会处理可用的源音频，并将带时间戳的语音证据纳入相应的记忆记录中。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 13 API-served models on all 5,214 questions in 4DMemoryBench using 4DMemory Harness , without benchmark-specific parameter updates. Each system uses Gemini 3.1 Pro as a separate media observer, enabling evaluated models to access evidence from modalities they cannot process directly. To reduce dependence on a single judge, we assess the same model responses under two independent judging protocols: an Opus-5 judge and a majority-vote panel comprising Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, and Qwen3.8-Max. Tool invocation and execution are assessed separately, and performance is summarized through four complementary metrics. Invocation measures the fraction of questions with at least one accepted tool call, while Ordered measures the fraction of these questions answered correctly with all required operations successfully executed in the prescribed order. Order-relaxed removes the execution-order constraint, while Overall measures the resulting joint success rate over all benchmark questions.

paragraphs.en: The overall results in Table 2 show that frequent tool invocation leaves substantial room for improving joint success. Twelve of the 13 systems invoke tools on at least 98.70% of questions, yet the highest observed Overall score is 77.79%, achieved by Muse Spark-1.1, followed by Grok-4.6 (75.55%) and Gemini 3.7-Flash (73.34%). The latter difference corresponds to 364 correctly answered questions with successful required operations but an ordering violation. paragraphs.en: The standalone-video subtype results reveal a consistent weakness in distributed counting across six subtypes covering 2,785 questions. Every system has a lower observed counting score than ordering score, and the best counting result is only 47.58% (Muse; 177/372), with complete judging. This gap also holds for fully evaluated systems: GPT-5.6 Sol scores 72.49% on ordering versus 44.35% on counting, while Gemini 3.7-Flash scores 82.17% versus 45.43%. Thus, ordering events does not ensure reliable accumulation of counts across separated observations. Other subtypes expose complementary strengths: Grok leads observed ordering and cross-modal binding at 83.19% and 81.58%, Muse leads state-change tracking at 73.80%, and Qwen3.8-Max leads trajectory tracking at 66.46%. Some leading entries remain provisional, as marked in 3 . Together, these results identify both a shared counting weakness and distinct capability profiles that aggregate accuracy would obscure.

paragraphs.en: We introduced LongVideo and 4DMemoryBench to evaluate long-horizon multimodal memory across dozens of hours of video. The benchmark comprises approximately 887 hours of video and covers visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning. Our 4DMemory Harness combines question-independent persistent memory, bounded retrieval, and specialized tools, with separate metrics for tool invocation, execution order, and joint answer success. Across 13 evaluated models, high invocation rates coexist with substantial differences in workflow compliance and final-answer correctness, with the highest observed joint success reaching 77.79% under judging. Task-level analyses reveal persistent difficulties in distributed counting and multi-scope aggregation, while differences across sources and temporal scopes expose complementary system strengths. These findings establish a basis for studying how observation, memory access, and tool-mediated computation jointly support reliable reasoning over extended multimodal histories.

paragraphs.en: Long-video benchmarks increasingly test evidence integration over extended temporal spans ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . LongVideoBench and Video-MME extend evaluation to hour-long inputs and multiple modality streams, while MLVU broadens video genres and task formats ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . TempCompass and VSI-Bench isolate fine-grained temporal reasoning and spatial memory, respectively ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Agentic approaches treat long-video understanding as iterative evidence acquisition through observation selection, tool use, and reasoning-state updates. The two VideoAgent systems exemplify query-driven frame retrieval and structured temporal or object memory, respectively ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Ataallah et al., 2025 ; Jia et al., 2026c ; Jia et al., 2026a ) . Retrieval- and planning-centered systems convert videos into searchable evidence, zoom across space and time, and control the scope and density of each observation ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Memory-centric agents organize episodic, semantic, visual, or hierarchical representations for iterative retrieval and reasoning ( Yeo et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) . LongVT and VideoThinker internalize multi-step tool use through model-specific post-training or synthetic tool-interaction trajectories ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Beyond video-specific systems, Skill Retrieval Augmentation decomposes scalable skill use into retrieval, incorporation, and end-task execution, while AgenticSTS uses typed retrieval to bound long-horizon decision contexts and isolate memory layers ( Li et al., 2026c ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . More generally, EnvHarness reshapes static agent environments through Stage, Contract, and Chain plug-ins while retaining their original verifiers, and EnvRigger uses black-box policy rollouts to diagnose weaknesses and validate targeted customizations ( Huang et al., 2026a ) . MemoHarness instead adapts six harness control dimensions from accumulated execution experience and reports selective transfer across unseen task suites and base models ( Huang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式方法将长视频理解视为通过观察选择、工具使用和推理状态更新进行的迭代式证据获取。 两个 VideoAgent 系统分别代表了查询驱动的帧检索和结构化的时序或对象记忆 ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Ataallah et al., 2025 ; Jia et al., 2026c ; Jia et al., 2026a ) 。 以检索和规划为中心的系统将视频转换为可搜索的证据，在空间和时间上进行缩放，并控制每次观察的范围和密度 ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) 。 以记忆为中心的智能体组织情景、语义、视觉或分层表示，用于迭代式检索和推理 ( Yeo et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) 。 LongVT 和 VideoThinker 通过针对特定模型的后训练或合成的工具交互轨迹，将多步工具使用内化 ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) 。 除视频专用系统之外，Skill Retrieval Augmentation 将可扩展的技能使用分解为检索、合并和末端任务执行，而 AgenticSTS 使用类型化检索来约束长程决策上下文并隔离记忆层 ( Li et al., 2026c ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) 。 更一般地，EnvHarness 通过 Stage、Contract 和 Chain 插件重塑静态智能体环境，同时保留其原始验证器，而 EnvRigger 使用黑盒策略推演来诊断弱点并验证有针对性的定制 ( Huang et al., 2026a ) 。 MemoHarness 则根据积累的执行经验调整六个 harness 控制维度，并报告了在未见过的任务套件和基础模型上的选择性迁移 ( Huang et al., 2026b ) 。

LoCoMo covers question answering, event summarization, and multimodal dialogue generation, while LongMemEval tests extraction, cross-session and temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, and abstention ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025a ) . paragraphs.en: The standalone collection comprises 1,025 web videos sourced from Qwen-Planner-Agent’s datasets Qu et al. (2026) , including 899 base videos and 126 extension videos. Sources are deduplicated by identifier and selected for compositional QA construction following Section 2.2 , with durations ranging from 19.93 minutes to 3.86 hours. Content covers crafts and DIY, food and cooking, travel and culture, nature and environment, games and hobbies, science and technology, programming and software, business and finance, and history, politics, and law. The serialized collection comprises 402 episodes from the Chinese-language series iPartment and the English-language series The Big Bang Theory , spanning 17 seasons and 193.299 hours. Their story themes include romantic relationships, marriage and family life, friendships, and workplace experiences. We preserve episode identifiers, original timestamps, and chronological order. For composition analysis, content labels are derived from standalone video descriptions and episode-level story summaries, with semantically related low-frequency categories merged for reporting.

paragraphs.en: The resulting benchmark contains 5,214 question–answer pairs, comprising 826 TV questions and 4,388 Video questions, designed to assess evidence retrieval, aggregation, and relational reasoning across temporal scales. TV questions span individual episodes, seasons, and entire series, with a single question covering up to 278 episodes. Their 42 task subtypes fall into three families: visual perception and aggregation (27.4%), textual understanding and statistics (45.6%), and spatiotemporal reasoning (27.0%). Representative tasks include person–object count comparisons, speaker-level dialogue statistics, first-appearance ordering, and tracking temporal changes across episodes. Video questions cover 12 task subtypes that require integrating evidence from multiple clips within a continuous timeline, including multi-event ordering, multi-evidence comparison, state-change tracking, distributed counting, and cross-modal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 所得的基准包含5,214个问答对，其中826个为电视节目（TV）问题、4,388个为视频（Video）问题，旨在评估跨时间尺度的证据检索、聚合与关系推理。 电视节目问题涵盖单集、整季乃至整个剧集系列，单个问题最多覆盖278集。 其42个任务子类型分为三大类：视觉感知与聚合（27.4%）、文本理解与统计（45.6%），以及时空推理（27.0%）。 具有代表性的任务包括人物—物体数量比较、说话人级别的对话统计、首次出场顺序排序，以及跨集追踪时间变化。 视频问题涵盖12个任务子类型，要求在连续时间线内整合来自多个片段的证据，包括多事件排序、多证据比较、状态变化追踪、分布式计数以及跨模态推理。

paragraphs.en: For standalone videos, scene-change detection determines the initial clip boundaries, with additional splitting for scenes exceeding the configured duration limit. Audio is extracted and transcribed only for clips containing audio tracks, while sampled frames are used to generate visual captions. For television episodes, coarse segments are formed by placing boundaries at ASR sentence endings closest to the target partition times. Multimodal analysis subsequently divides these segments into coherent units according to changes in scene, dialogue topic, and speaker interaction. Where available, the audio-analysis branch additionally produces semantic summaries, topic and emotion annotations, and audio-quality assessments.
paragraphs.zh: 对于独立视频，通过场景切换检测确定初始片段边界，并对超过配置时长上限的场景进行额外切分。 仅对包含音频轨的片段提取并转录音频，同时利用采样帧生成视觉描述。 对于电视剧剧集，通过在接近目标分割时间的 ASR 句子结尾处设置边界，形成粗粒度分段。 随后，多模态分析根据场景、对话主题和说话人交互的变化，将这些分段划分为连贯的单元。 在可用的情况下，音频分析分支还会生成语义摘要、主题与情感标注，以及音频质量评估。

paragraphs.en: Post-processing merges consecutive utterances attributed to the same speaker, retaining the first utterance’s start time and the last utterance’s end time. Both clip and utterance timestamps are converted from segment-local coordinates to the original source timeline by adding the parent segment’s start-time offset. The resulting intervals guide the extraction of fine-grained video clips and utterance-level audio segments, together with frame sampling from the video clips. For television sources, this conversion is performed within each episode, preserving its original temporal reference. An optional calibration utility matches annotated utterances to ASR segments using text similarity and can further refine their boundaries using voice activity detection. The selected calibration method is recorded in the processing metadata.

paragraphs.en: The agent first calls inspect_video_size , which reports the sizes of its bound sources and estimates request sizes with base64 expansion and serialization overhead. When segmentation is required, video_process_split accepts only indices identifying those sources. Splitting is mandatory when request limits are exceeded and can also be required by the configured audio-transcription pathway. The FFmpeg adapter transcodes contiguous intervals and recursively bisects outputs that exceed the configured byte limit. Its manifest records source-relative temporal bounds, file sizes, and content hashes, and validation checks interval continuity and coverage. The current adapter permits an explicit exception for a final interval of at most two seconds containing no decodable video frames; any such omission is recorded in the manifest.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体首先调用 inspect_video_size，该工具报告其绑定的源的大小，并结合 base64 扩展与序列化开销估算请求大小。 当需要切分时，video_process_split 只接受标识这些源的索引。 当超出请求限制时切分为强制要求，配置的音频转录路径也可能要求切分。 FFmpeg 适配器对连续区间进行转码，并对超出配置字节上限的输出递归二分。 其清单记录相对源的时间边界、文件大小和内容哈希，验证环节检查区间的连续性与覆盖情况。 当前适配器允许对时长至多两秒且不含可解码视频帧的末尾区间作显式例外处理；任何此类遗漏都会记录在清单中。

paragraphs.en: Fresh episode inference uses trusted prepared frame inputs, while longer-scope inference reconstructs frames from the bound raw videos using the retained temporal boundaries. Counts represent distinct tracker identities within individual clips and are summed across clips, without global identity deduplication. The underlying library also supports spatial histograms using normalized image coordinates with a top-left origin, but these projections are not exposed by the current agent-facing schemas. With skill caching enabled, hybrid mode reuses provenance-matched artifacts and performs local inference on a cache miss. Cold mode requests fresh computation, whereas warm mode requires a valid cached artifact. This specialist is currently TV-scoped; standalone visual evidence is supplied through the media observer and memory retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 新片段推理使用可信的准备帧输入，而更长范围的推理则使用保留的时间边界从绑定的原始视频重建帧。 计数表示单个片段内不同的跟踪器身份，并在各片段间求和，不进行全局身份去重。 底层库还支持使用左上角原点的归一化图像坐标的空间直方图，但当前面向智能体的模式并未暴露这些投影。 在启用技能缓存的情况下，混合模式会重用来源匹配的产物，并在缓存未命中时执行本地推理。 冷模式请求全新计算，而暖模式则要求存在有效的缓存产物。 该专家目前仅限于电视范围；独立的视觉证据通过媒体观察者和记忆检索提供。

sents.en: Counts represent distinct tracker identities within individual clips and are summed across clips, without global identity deduplication.
sents.zh: 计数表示单个片段内不同的跟踪器身份，并在各片段间求和，不进行全局身份去重。

sents.en: The underlying library also supports spatial histograms using normalized image coordinates with a top-left origin, but these projections are not exposed by the current agent-facing schemas.
sents.zh: 底层库还支持使用左上角原点的归一化图像坐标的空间直方图，但当前面向智能体的模式并未暴露这些投影。

sents.en: With skill caching enabled, hybrid mode reuses provenance-matched artifacts and performs local inference on a cache miss.
sents.zh: 在启用技能缓存的情况下，混合模式会重用来源匹配的产物，并在缓存未命中时执行本地推理。

sents.en: Cold mode requests fresh computation, whereas warm mode requires a valid cached artifact.
sents.zh: 冷模式请求全新计算，而暖模式则要求存在有效的缓存产物。

sents.en: This specialist is currently TV-scoped; standalone visual evidence is supplied through the media observer and memory retrieval.
sents.zh: 该专家目前仅限于电视范围；独立的视觉证据通过媒体观察者和记忆检索提供。

paragraphs.en: The offline build command derives dialogue-block counts, dialogue-line counts, ASR-sentence counts, and normalized speaker statistics from the configured TV annotations. The validate command checks source fingerprints, corpus coverage, aggregate consistency, and provenance. The agent-facing text_statistics_query exposes bounded projections through the episode , season , and info actions, with info addressing the full configured series. These deterministic CPU queries return counts, means, leading speakers, and relevant extrema without model inference.
paragraphs.zh: 离线构建命令从已配置的电视标注中导出对话块数量、对话行数量、ASR 句子数量以及归一化的说话人统计信息。 校验命令检查源指纹、语料库覆盖率、聚合一致性以及数据来源。 面向智能体的 text_statistics_query 通过 episode 、 season 和 info 操作暴露有边界的投影，其中 info 针对完整配置的剧集系列。 这些确定性的 CPU 查询无需模型推理即可返回数量、均值、主要说话人以及相关的极值。

paragraphs.en: For semantic analysis, text_statistics_analyze operates on one episode. It first retains a bounded set of non-empty dialogue lines, using uniform sampling when the episode exceeds the configured limit. Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B then matches these lines to predefined topic descriptions and ranks representative lines by embedding similarity. Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 receives bounded dialogue evidence and topic statistics to generate a structured summary containing themes, key events, speaker dynamics, and supporting sentence identifiers. The output is validated against the supplied identifiers, and reusable analyses follow the configured provenance-aware cache policy. These embeddings serve episode-level text analysis; the memory retriever separately uses lexical matching and temporal-neighbor expansion.
paragraphs.zh: 在语义分析方面，text_statistics_analyze 针对单个回合（episode）进行操作。 它首先保留一组数量有界的非空对话行，当回合超过配置的上限时采用均匀采样。 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 随后将这些对话行与预定义的主题描述进行匹配，并按嵌入相似度对代表性对话行进行排序。 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 接收有界的对话证据和主题统计数据，生成包含主题、关键事件、说话者动态以及支撑句标识符的结构化摘要。 输出会根据提供的标识符进行验证，可复用的分析遵循配置的具备来源感知的缓存策略。 这些嵌入用于回合级文本分析；记忆检索器则单独使用词法匹配和时间邻近扩展。

paragraphs.en: On a cache miss, the observation stage processes one prepared temporal unit using the actual observer’s supported media interface. Native-video input is used where supported; otherwise, a compatibility adapter supplies a timestamped sequence of sampled frames. Text-only evaluated models use a separately configured multimodal observer while retaining responsibility for retrieval, tool use, and final reasoning. The observer receives neither the benchmark question nor reference answers or private evidence annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 在缓存未命中时，观察阶段使用实际观察者所支持的媒体接口处理一个已准备好的时序单元。 在支持的地方使用原生视频输入；否则，由兼容性适配器提供带时间戳的采样帧序列。 纯文本被评测模型使用单独配置的多模态观察者，同时保留检索、工具使用和最终推理的职责。 观察者既不会收到基准问题，也不会收到参考答案或私有证据标注。

paragraphs.en: For frame-based observation, the visual prompt requires the transcript field to remain empty. When the audio observer is enabled, a resident Faster-Whisper large-v3 runtime independently transcribes the source audio, using automatic language detection under the current configuration. Chunk-local transcription times are converted to source-relative times by adding the chunk’s start-time offset. The transcript is then attached to the corresponding visual memory document. Missing audio tracks or the absence of detected speech produce explicitly empty transcription results. Audio and visual artifacts are cached independently, allowing valid visual observations to be reused when speech evidence is added to unchanged temporal units. The resulting evidence is accessed through memory retrieval; the agent is not given a separate transcription interface accepting filesystem paths.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于帧的观察，视觉提示要求 transcript 字段保持为空。 当音频观察器启用时，一个常驻的 Faster-Whisper large-v3 运行时会独立地对源音频进行转录，并在当前配置下使用自动语言检测。 分块局部的转录时间通过加上该分块的起始时间偏移量，转换为相对于源的时间。 转录结果随后被附加到相应的视觉记忆文档中。 缺失的音轨或未检测到语音的情况会产生明确为空的转录结果。 音频与视觉产物独立缓存，当语音证据被添加到未发生变化的时间单元时，有效的视觉观察可以被复用。 所得证据通过记忆检索访问；不会为智能体提供一个接受文件系统路径的独立转录接口。

paragraphs.en: Successful observations are normalized into documents containing a summary, transcript, on-screen text, entities, actions, events, and spatial relations, together with source identity and temporal bounds. Unavailable fields remain empty. Cache keys bind the source and temporal-unit hashes to the actual observer, observation prompt, input adapter, processing configuration, and generation settings. The audio cache additionally records the local ASR checkpoint and runtime identity. A combined audio-visual document derives its identity from both component artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 成功的观察会被规范化为文档，其中包含摘要、转录文本、屏幕文字、实体、动作、事件和空间关系，以及来源标识和时间边界。 不可用的字段保持为空。 缓存键将来源与时间单元的哈希绑定到实际的观察者、观察提示、输入适配器、处理配置和生成设置。 音频缓存还会记录本地 ASR 检查点和运行时标识。 音视频组合文档的标识由其两个组成部分的工件共同派生。

paragraphs.en: When enabled, episode, season, and series manifests reference the underlying document keys and retain aggregate scope metadata. Matching observations can therefore be reused across questions and broader temporal scopes, while newly encountered units require observation. Different reasoners may share memory when the source units and actual observation configurations match. Hybrid mode reuses valid artifacts and constructs missing ones; cold mode bypasses persistent reuse, whereas warm mode requires valid cached artifacts for mandatory operations. The cache policies are summarized in next paragraph.
paragraphs.zh: 启用后，剧集、季和剧集系列的清单会引用底层文档键，并保留聚合范围的元数据。 因此，匹配的观测可以在不同问题和更广的时间范围之间复用，而新遇到的单元则需要重新观测。 当源单元和实际观测配置匹配时，不同的智能体可以共享记忆。 混合模式会复用有效的工件并构建缺失的工件；冷模式绕过持久化复用，而暖模式要求强制操作必须存在有效的缓存工件。 缓存策略在下一段中进行总结。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval is restricted to the documents bound to the current evaluation item. The initial query contains the question and any provided answer options. The retriever ranks the bounded textual representations of structured memory using term-frequency and inverse-document-frequency weights, with an additional bonus for exact query matches. It selects up to 12 seed documents and expands each seed by a 1-unit neighborhood on either side within the same source. The expanded set is deduplicated and packed under the configured record and text budgets. If the initial retrieval score falls below the configured threshold, the harness instead supplies a bounded set of evenly spaced temporal units.
paragraphs.zh: 检索范围仅限于绑定到当前评估项的文档。 初始查询包含问题以及所提供的任何答案选项。 检索器使用词频和逆文档频率权重对结构化记忆的有界文本表示进行排序，并对与查询完全匹配的情况给予额外加分。 它最多选择 12 个种子文档，并在同一来源内以 1 个单位的邻域向两侧扩展每个种子文档。 扩展后的集合会去重，并在配置的记录和文本预算内打包。 如果初始检索得分低于配置的阈值，测试框架将改为提供一组有界的、均匀分布的时间单元。

paragraphs.en: The reasoner can issue further textual queries through video_memory_query within the configured execution budget. Each response retains source indices and temporal bounds and searches the same item-bound document collection. Under the cached evaluation protocol, a successful memory query is required before the final answer. Available visual-grounding and text-statistics operations provide additional evidence within their supported scopes. The final reasoning stage receives textual memory and tool results, without receiving the full raw-video history. Because observation and retrieval are bounded, persistent storage neither enlarges the native context window nor guarantees lossless retention or complete recall.

paragraphs.en: The evaluation comprises 4,388 standalone-video questions and 826 television questions. Results are grouped into visual, textual, and spatiotemporal task families, with television results further organized by episode, season, and complete-series scope. All models listed in Table 2 are evaluated on the complete question set under the staged 4DMemory Harness . API inference is hosted remotely, while orchestration, media preparation, caching, retrieval, and specialist inference run on a node equipped with eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 该评测包含 4,388 个独立视频问题和 826 个电视问题。 结果按视觉、文本和时空任务族分组，电视结果还进一步按单集、整季和全剧范围组织。 表 2 中列出的所有模型均在分阶段的 4DMemory Harness 下于完整问题集上进行评测。 API 推理由远程托管，而编排、媒体准备、缓存、检索和专业推理则在配备八块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 的节点上运行。

paragraphs.en: All staged profiles use hybrid caching, reusing artifacts whose provenance matches the requested configuration and constructing missing memory without access to benchmark questions, reference answers, or private evidence annotations. Most multimodal profiles use the evaluated model itself as the media observer. Qwen3.8-Max, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and the GLM-5.3-Flash recovery profile instead use Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview to construct visual memory. We therefore compare complete reasoner–observer systems and record both roles explicitly. Run manifests preserve model identities, decoding and runtime settings, configuration and implementation hashes, and cache provenance to support reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: 所有预置配置均采用混合缓存，复用来源信息与所请求配置相匹配的产物，并在不接触基准问题、参考答案或私有证据标注的情况下构建缺失的记忆。 大多数多模态配置使用被评估的模型本身作为媒体观察者。 Qwen3.8-Max、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 以及 GLM-5.3-Flash 恢复配置则改用 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 来构建视觉记忆。 因此，我们比较完整的「推理者–观察者」系统，并明确记录两个角色。 运行清单保存模型身份、解码与运行时设置、配置与实现哈希值以及缓存来源，以支持可复现性。

paragraphs.en: Answer correctness and skill use are evaluated separately. Answer judges receive the question, candidate response, and private reference answer. Skill-use assessment instead receives the required operations, tool traces, and execution metadata without access to the reference answer. We report two answer-judging protocols: a single Opus-5 judge and a three-model panel comprising Kimi-K3, GLM-5.3, and Qwen3.8-Max. The Opus-5 score follows its answer verdict without deterministic exact-match overrides. The panel requires three valid decisions and applies a two-of-three majority rule. Both protocols evaluate the same model responses and share the same tool-execution records.
paragraphs.zh: 回答正确性与技能使用分开评估。 回答评判智能体接收问题、候选回复以及私密的参考答案。 技能使用评估则接收所需操作、工具调用轨迹和执行元数据，但无法访问参考答案。 我们报告两种回答评判协议：单一 Opus-5 评判者，以及由 Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3 和 Qwen3.8-Max 组成的三模型评审团。 Opus-5 分数遵循其回答判定结果，不使用确定性的精确匹配覆盖。 评审团要求三个有效判定，并采用三票中两票的多数规则。 两种协议评估相同的模型回复，并共享相同的工具执行记录。

paragraphs.en: Tool invocation and execution are determined from recorded traces. Let N N denote the number of evaluated questions and B B the number with at least one accepted tool invocation. For each answer-judging protocol, let C C count questions answered correctly with all required call groups successfully executed in the prescribed order. Let D D count additional correctly answered questions whose successful calls cover the required groups but do not satisfy their ordering constraints. We report Invocation as B / N B/N , Ordered as C / B C/B , Order-relaxed as ( C + D ) / B (C+D)/B , and Overall as ( C + D ) / N (C+D)/N . An accepted invocation may encounter a tool error; only successful calls satisfy execution requirements. Invocation is reported once because it is identical across the two judging protocols.

paragraphs.en: The local tool stack uses the SAM 3.1 multiplex checkpoint for visual grounding, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 for text analysis, and Faster-Whisper 1.2.1 with the large-v3 checkpoint for audio transcription. Text analysis uses bfloat16 inference, a batch size of 16, and an 8,192-token input limit. Audio transcription uses float16 inference, beam size 5, voice-activity detection, and automatic language identification. Persistent tool daemons retain model weights, and trusted GPU locks coordinate local inference across concurrent evaluation processes.
paragraphs.zh: 本地工具栈使用 SAM 3.1 多路复用检查点进行视觉定位，使用 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 和 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 进行文本分析，并使用配备 large-v3 检查点的 Faster-Whisper 1.2.1 进行音频转录。 文本分析使用 bfloat16 推理、大小为 16 的批次以及 8,192 个词元的输入上限。 音频转录使用 float16 推理、束大小 5、语音活动检测以及自动语言识别。 持久化的工具守护进程会保留模型权重，而受信任的 GPU 锁则在并发的评估进程之间协调本地推理。

paragraphs.en: The media adapter targets 24-second chunks with a 3.4 MB chunk-size bound and recursively splits oversized units, subject to a 20 MB request-body limit. Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Grok-4.6 use timestamped JPEG frame sequences sampled at three-second intervals, capped at eight frames per chunk with a maximum image edge of 768 pixels. Native-video routes receive bounded video inputs, and standalone frame-based observations are supplemented with local ASR. All current staged profiles use hybrid caching, reusing only provenance-matched artifacts and constructing missing memory from the media without the question or reference answer. Lexical retrieval selects 12 seed memory units and expands one temporal neighbor on either side within the same source. Individual observation notes are bounded to 4,000 characters and the combined evidence summary to 64,000 characters.
paragraphs.zh: 媒体适配器以 24 秒的分块为目标，并设定 3.4 MB 的分块大小上限，对超限的单元进行递归拆分，同时受 20 MB 请求体上限的约束。 Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Grok-4.6 使用以三秒为间隔采样、带时间戳的 JPEG 帧序列，每个分块最多八帧，图像最长边不超过 768 像素。 原生视频路由接收有界的视频输入，独立的基于帧的观测则辅以本地 ASR。 目前所有分阶段配置均采用混合缓存，仅复用来源匹配的产物，并在不包含问题或参考答案的情况下从媒体中构建缺失的记忆。 词法检索选取 12 个种子记忆单元，并在同一来源内扩展每侧各一个时间相邻单元。 单条观测笔记的上限为 4,000 字符，组合后的证据摘要上限为 64,000 字符。

paragraphs.en: The preparation and reasoning loops allow four and eight rounds, respectively, with an eight-call tool budget for each loop and a 16,000-character tool-output limit. The default API request uses temperature 0, a 2,048-token output budget, and a 600-second timeout. Model-specific request adapters retain the required token and reasoning controls, including an 8,192-token minimum output budget for Muse-Spark-1.1. The evaluator selection seed is 42; local visual and text tools use seed 0, without assuming deterministic behavior from hosted APIs. Current recovery runs use 8–48 item workers and 16–32 in-flight evaluated requests per model, with shared provider gates enforcing 60–300 requests per minute. GPU-capable work is separately limited to four candidate workers. Retries and resumed runs are tracked by question identifier and source/configuration provenance, and completed model answers can be rescored without rerunning inference.
paragraphs.zh: 准备和推理循环分别允许四轮和八轮，每个循环的工具调用预算为八次，工具输出上限为 16,000 字符。 默认的 API 请求使用温度 0、2,048 个 token 的输出预算以及 600 秒的超时时间。 特定于模型的请求适配器保留了所需的 token 和推理控制项，包括 Muse-Spark-1.1 的 8,192 个 token 的最低输出预算。 评估器选择的随机种子为 42；本地视觉和文本工具使用种子 0，且不假定托管式 API 具有确定性行为。 当前的恢复运行使用 8–48 个条目工作进程，每个模型并行进行 16–32 个评估中的请求，并由共享的提供商网关强制执行每分钟 60–300 个请求的限制。 涉及 GPU 的工作被单独限制为四个候选工作进程。 重试和恢复的运行按问题标识符及来源/配置溯源信息进行追踪，已完成的模型答案无需重新运行推理即可重新评分。

paragraphs.en: Answer correctness and skill use are evaluated separately. Private reference answers are restricted to the answer judge, while tool traces and provenance are supplied to the skill-use judge. The current online scoring route uses claude-opus-5 , while a separate judge-only track obtains votes from kimi-k3 , glm-5.3 , and qwen3.8-max for both dimensions. The three-judge track requires three valid decisions before applying a two-of-three majority rule. Missing or failed judge calls remain pending rather than being converted into negative votes, and these results are kept separate from the Opus-only scores. Each run records the selected question identifiers, resolved model and observer routes, decoding and concurrency settings, code and configuration hashes, cache policy, and termination status.
paragraphs.zh: 回答正确性与技能使用分开评估。 私有参考答案仅提供给回答裁判，而工具调用轨迹和来源信息则提供给技能使用裁判。 当前的在线评分路线使用 claude-opus-5，而另一条仅供裁判使用的赛道则由 kimi-k3、glm-5.3 和 qwen3.8-max 为两个维度投票。 三裁判赛道在应用三取二多数规则之前，需要先获得三个有效判定。 缺失或失败的裁判调用保持待定状态，而不会被转换为反对票，这些结果与仅使用 Opus 的评分分开保存。 每次运行都会记录所选的问题标识符、解析后的模型和观察者路线、解码与并发设置、代码和配置哈希、缓存策略以及终止状态。

paragraphs.en: Table S1 shows that success on episode-level visual questions does not predict the same ranking on season-level questions. GPT-5.6 scores 99.42% on episodes and 56.00% on seasons, whereas Grok-4.6 scores 27.33% and 80.00%, respectively. Muse-1.1 is comparatively strong on both, at 94.77% and 76.00%. On standalone visual questions, the highest observed three-judge score is 54.95% from Grok-4.6, indicating substantial remaining headroom in that group. Complete-series visual results contain only four questions, so one answer changes the score by 25 percentage points and a 100% result provides limited evidence of robustness.

paragraphs.en: In Table S2 , all 12 systems other than Qwen3.8-Flash score at least 98.14% on episode-level text questions, although several entries remain provisional. Other scopes expose larger differences: GPT-5.6 scores 96.03% on season-level text and 72.22% on complete-series text, while MiMo-2.5 scores 92.86% and 91.67%. Standalone text accuracy also varies substantially, from a provisional 31.93% for Seed-2.1 to 78.15% for Gemini-3.7. Thus, near-saturation on episode-level text questions does not imply uniformly reliable aggregation or reasoning across the other text groups.
paragraphs.zh: 在表S2中，除Qwen3.8-Flash外的全部12个系统在剧集级文本问题上均得分至少98.14%，不过其中若干条目仍为暂定结果。 其他范围则暴露出更大的差异：GPT-5.6在季级文本上得96.03%，在整剧文本上得72.22%，而MiMo-2.5则分别为92.86%和91.67%。 纯文本准确率也存在显著差异，从Seed-2.1的暂定31.93%到Gemini-3.7的78.15%不等。 因此，在剧集级文本问题上的接近饱和并不意味着在其他文本分组上的聚合或推理同样可靠。

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.6 has complete three-judge results across all groups; its television spatiotemporal accuracy falls from 87.86% at episode scope to 38.98% at season scope and 12.50% at complete-series scope ( Table S3 ). This decline is not explained by pending judgments, but the groups contain different reasoning operations, so it cannot be attributed solely to temporal span. Other systems follow different profiles: Muse-1.1 scores 100.00% on episodes and 86.44% on seasons, while Grok-4.6 scores 91.43% and 86.44%. Standalone spatiotemporal questions account for 4,039 of the 5,214 snapshot items (77.46%); consequently, a single micro-averaged benchmark score would primarily reflect this group. The task-by-scope breakdown exposes differences that such an aggregate could obscure.

paragraphs.en: Table S4 localizes the reversal between GPT-5.6 and Grok-4.6. GPT-5.6 solves all 64 person-minus-object count questions and scores 99.07% on person-to-object count ratios, but solves only one of 17 above-mean unit-count questions (5.88%). Grok-4.6 scores 29.69% and 25.93% on the first two subtypes, but 82.35% on above-mean counting. Muse-1.1 scores 98.44%, 92.59%, and 70.59%, respectively. These results distinguish direct count comparisons from operations that require computing a threshold and applying it across temporal units. Because subtype and scope are not controlled independently, the contrast identifies an operation-specific performance gap without isolating its cause.

paragraphs.en: GPT-5.6 solves all 64 first-appearance ordering and localization questions, yet solves only one of 16 temporal-half count comparisons (6.25%) and one of 17 trend-reversal questions (5.88%; Table S5 ). The contrast suggests that retrieving and ordering a small set of first occurrences is insufficient for reliable aggregation over an ordered sequence of counts. It does not establish whether the failing stage is evidence retrieval, tool execution, or final computation, because joint accuracy requires all of these stages to succeed. paragraphs.en: The six selected video subtypes in Table 3 reveal a common gap between event ordering and distributed counting. GPT-5.6 scores 72.49% on 1,374 multi-event ordering questions but 44.35% on 372 distributed-counting questions, a 28.14-point difference with both groups fully judged. Opus-4.8 also has fully judged distributed-counting results and scores 45.97%; the highest observed score in that column is Muse-1.1’s 47.58%, also with complete judging. Every system with a reported three-judge score performs worse on distributed counting than on event ordering. This pattern is consistent with difficulty accumulating evidence across separated events, although aggregate scores alone cannot distinguish omissions, duplicate counting, and arithmetic errors.
paragraphs.zh: 表3中选取的六种视频子类型揭示了事件排序与分布式计数之间的普遍差距。 GPT-5.6 在1,374道多事件排序题上得分72.49%，但在372道分布式计数题上得分仅为44.35%，在两组均被完整评审的情况下相差28.14分。 Opus-4.8 同样拥有被完整评审的分布式计数结果，得分为45.97%；该列中观察到的最高分是 Muse-1.1 的47.58%，同样具备完整评审。 每一个报告了三评审得分的系统，在分布式计数上的表现都逊于事件排序。 这一模式与跨分离事件累积证据的难度相一致，尽管仅凭聚合分数无法区分遗漏、重复计数和算术错误。

paragraphs.en: The paired task-by-scope scores also expose sensitivity to the evaluation protocol. For MiMo-2.5 on complete-series spatiotemporal questions, Opus-only and three-judge scores are 79.17% and 70.83%, with complete judging under both protocols. GPT-5.6 also has complete judging under both protocols, but its standalone spatiotemporal score changes from 69.20% to 67.96%. These aggregate differences do not quantify inter-judge agreement, which requires a separate comparison of matched item-level votes. The results characterize the evaluated reasoner–observer–tool systems under the stated metric; without matched standalone-model runs or component ablations, they do not measure a causal gain from the harness or identify a unique failure mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 按任务与范围配对的分数还暴露了对评估协议的敏感性。 对于 MiMo-2.5 在完整系列的时空问题上，仅 Opus 评审与三评委评审的分数分别为 79.17% 和 70.83%，两种协议下均为完整评审。 GPT-5.6 在两种协议下同样为完整评审，但其独立时空分数从 69.20% 变为 67.96%。 这些总体差异并未量化评委之间的一致性，后者需要对逐条匹配的条目级投票进行单独比较。 这些结果在所述指标下刻画了被评估的推理器–观察器–工具系统；由于缺乏匹配的独立模型运行或组件消融实验，它们并不能衡量来自智能体框架的因果增益，也不能确定唯一的失败机制。

paragraphs.en: Our findings should be interpreted within the benchmark’s current coverage and evaluation setting. The serialized collection covers two sitcoms, and the task distribution emphasizes spatiotemporal reasoning over video-derived evidence. Automated annotation and model-based judging introduce uncertainty, while performance depends on observation quality, retrieval budgets, and tool execution. The reported scores therefore characterize the evaluated reasoner–observer–tool systems as a whole.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的发现应结合该基准测试当前的覆盖范围和评估设置来解读。 该序列化数据集涵盖了两部情景喜剧，任务分布强调基于视频证据的时空推理。 自动化标注和基于模型的评判会引入不确定性，而性能则取决于观察质量、检索预算和工具执行情况。 因此，所报告的分数刻画的是被评估的推理器-观察器-工具系统整体的表现。

paragraphs.en: Future work will explore broader domains and continuous streams to evaluate memory updates, entity persistence, and reasoning across temporal scales. Matched evaluations with controlled observation inputs and inference budgets can clarify the contributions of memory representations, retrieval policies, and specialist tools. Promising directions include quantity-aware memory with explicit temporal provenance, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and source-level human verification to strengthen evaluation reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 未来工作将探索更广泛的领域和连续的数据流，以评估跨时间尺度的记忆更新、实体持久化与推理能力。 通过控制观测输入和推理预算进行匹配评估，可以厘清记忆表示、检索策略与专用工具各自的作用。 有前景的方向包括带有显式时间来源信息的数量感知记忆、不确定性引导的检索，以及源级人工验证，以增强评估的可靠性。
